suppliers.name: Supplier A
suppliers.description: Contract manufacturer near Shanghai producing colour cosmetics and skincare creams for export; ships containers from Shanghai and Ningbo on the trans-Pacific lane to Los Angeles.

suppliers.name: Supplier B
suppliers.description: Mumbai-based manufacturer of haircare oils and wellness formulations; exports through Nhava Sheva (JNPT) and Mumbai port on the India-Europe lane to Rotterdam.

suppliers.name: Supplier C
suppliers.description: Vietnam contract manufacturer of cosmetics and fragrance products near Ho Chi Minh City; ships from Cat Lai and Cai Mep ports on the trans-Pacific lane to Los Angeles.

suppliers.name: Supplier D
suppliers.description: Netherlands supplier of premium skincare and wellness lines distributed through the Port of Rotterdam; feeds the Rotterdam DC and the trans-Atlantic lane to New York.

suppliers.name: Supplier E
suppliers.description: US-based supplier of fragrance and haircare products serving domestic replenishment by road from Los Angeles to Dallas.

facilities.name: Shanghai Port Consolidation Hub
facilities.description: Container consolidation hub at the Port of Shanghai; primary export gateway for China-sourced cosmetics and skincare on the trans-Pacific and Asia-Europe lanes.

facilities.name: Rotterdam DC
facilities.description: European distribution centre at the Port of Rotterdam handling India-Europe imports and trans-Atlantic outbound shipments to New York.

facilities.name: Los Angeles Import DC
facilities.description: West Coast import distribution centre receiving trans-Pacific cargo from Shanghai and Ho Chi Minh and feeding the domestic road lane to Dallas.

facilities.name: Bangalore Blending Plant
facilities.description: Blending and filling plant near Bangalore producing wellness and skincare formulations for the India-Europe and India-Middle East lanes.

lanes.name: Shanghai-Los Angeles
lanes.description: Trans-Pacific sea lane from Shanghai to Los Angeles carrying China-sourced cosmetics and skincare.

lanes.name: Ho Chi Minh-Los Angeles
lanes.description: Trans-Pacific sea lane from Ho Chi Minh City to Los Angeles carrying Vietnam-sourced cosmetics and fragrance.

lanes.name: Mumbai-Rotterdam
lanes.description: India-Europe sea lane from Mumbai (Nhava Sheva) to Rotterdam carrying haircare and wellness goods.

lanes.name: Rotterdam-New York
lanes.description: Trans-Atlantic sea lane from Rotterdam to New York carrying skincare and wellness lines.

lanes.name: Los Angeles-Dallas
lanes.description: Domestic US road lane from Los Angeles to Dallas for inland replenishment.

lanes.name: Mumbai-Dubai
lanes.description: India-Middle East air lane from Mumbai to Dubai for expedited high-value shipments.
